name: App Service
summary: Secure-by-default web app or function app: HTTPS only, TLS 1.2, no FTP or basic auth, managed identity, VNet integration and private endpoint.
useWhen: You need to host a web app or API on a managed PaaS runtime
You need an app that reaches private resources through VNet integration and managed identity
avoidWhen: You need containers orchestrated with scale to zero and Dapr (use Container Apps)
You need full control of the OS or runtime (use a VM or AKS)
